criteria.description: File to directory swap in one process: probeMissing returns null
criteria.note: SWAPS[0] (adapters.test.mjs:607-611) puts tools/select.js, probes it (null), replaces it with tools/select/index.js and asserts null. The stale-hit branch `return freshResolve(file) !== null` at adapters.js:391 produces that null. The test runs per-PR: test.yml runs on every pull_request with no paths filter, and `npm test` -> test:suite includes 'evals/loop-supervisor/unit/*.test.mjs'. No code or test file has changed between QA head 159f41a3 and PR head df3db764.

criteria.description: Reverse swap, directory to file, also returns null
criteria.note: SWAPS[1] ('directory → file', before tools/select/index.js, after tools/select.js) runs the same loop test at adapters.test.mjs:619. It runs per-PR through npm test in test.yml.

criteria.description: Stale hit with no replacement still reports probe script not found
criteria.note: Both swap tests end by removing tools/ and asserting that the reason starts with 'probe script not found: tools/select'. In that case resolveInFreshNode returns null, so resolvesAsMain returns false. The test runs per-PR through npm test.

criteria.description: freshResolve called only on stale hit; one exists call per probe
criteria.note: The test 'resolvesAsMain spawns a fresh resolve only on a stale hit' asserts 0 calls on a miss, 0 on a live hit and exactly [file] on a stale hit. freshResolve is reached only after the `if (fs.existsSync(resolved)) return true` check at line 390. The one-exists-call test at adapters.test.mjs:679 (formerly :597) is unchanged. A second mutation in the QA report (live hit also calls freshResolve) turned the spawn-count test red. Both tests run per-PR.
